# design-system

> Agent-first, minimalist React design system styled with StyleX. v0.1.0. Components are copied into your project with the CLI: `npx ds add <name>`.

## Components

- button: Triggers an action in place: submit a form, open a dialog, save. Docs: `npx ds docs button`.
- input: Single-line text field with a visible label, optional hint and error. Docs: `npx ds docs input`.

## Tokens

- [tokens.json](tokens/tokens.json): color, font, fontSize, fontWeight, lineHeight, space, radius, size. StyleX: `import { color, space } from "./tokens.stylex"`.

## Rules (`npx ds check`)

- no-raw-color: Colors must come from design tokens (color.* in tokens.stylex.ts), not raw hex/rgb/hsl values.

## Full docs

- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt)
